items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I never worked much with Kaiser.

ctx.x: Well, when you and I just started getting into New York in the '30s, let's see, who were some of the great drummers? I think George Wettling was around and there was -- who was -- Kaiser Marshall (PHONETIC), did you --
I never worked much with Kaiser. I was

very fond of Kaiser's drumming. I heard him with Fletcher Henderson's band years before in Detroit, before we came to New York. And I liked also, very much, Walter Johnson. Walter Johnson was the best drummer I heard playing an open-top cymbal, big cymbal on top of the drum and just letting it ring behind the solos.
